lines.text: This free Claude skill turns any topic into a Khan Academy style video.
You describe the video, and Claude draws every step on a blackboard.
Then a voice explains it, and the pen lands right on the words.
No API keys, no credits. It all runs on your own laptop.
The catch: it draws diagrams, not faces, so it's built for teaching.
And get this. It's open source on GitHub, with over a hundred stars.
For the repo link, comment BOARD.
